title: nan
authors: Zhou Q.; Tang H.; Zhang Z.; Xu Y.; Xiao F.; Jia Y.
key_contribution: Presents a hierarchical absolute visual localization system combining DINOv2 image retrieval, SuperPoint feature registration, IMU correction, and sliding-window map updating for UAVs in GNSS-denied environments.
problem_solved: Addressing state estimation drift in GNSS-denied navigation.
methodology_summary: Fuses sensor data using Radio_Based_Positioning to ensure precise positioning.
